title: Geometric hypotheses for the pulled-back target limit
statement: Let S be affine and p:X→S, g:T→S be scheme morphisms [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let D:I→Over T be small cofiltered with affine transitions and qcqs stage schemes, and c a cone with limiting underlying scheme cone. Set W=T×_S X [def-pc-fibre-product] and B=Over.pullback(pr_T). Then D followed by B has affine transitions, all its structure maps to X are quasi-compact and quasi-separated, its limit-cone structure map to X is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and the underlying scheme cone B(c) is limiting.

proof.text: Paste the pullback square for U×_T W with that for W=T×_S X. Base-change stability transfers quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of U→S to U×_T W→X. Each stage U→S is qcqs since U is qcqs and S is affine. MorphismProperty.overPullbackMap gives affine transitions. These assertions are proved directly in the delivered Lean using Mathlib.

Choose a stage (cofilteredness ensures one exists). Mathlib isAffineHom_π_app makes the corresponding original cone projection affine. The cone equation expresses the limit map to S as its composite with the qcqs stage map, so it is qcqs; apply the same pasted pullback square. Over.forget reflects the original limit; Over.pullback, being a right adjoint, preserves it; Over.forget preserves the connected resulting limit. All these assertions are proved directly in the delivered Lean.

baseChangeTargetFunctorIso in Coefficients identifies the single-complex target with the higher image. No natural comparison for iterated pullback stalk systems. Geometry follows directly from Mathlib overPullbackMap, IsPullback.paste_vert, isAffineHom_π_app and preservation of connected limits.

lean.statement: theorem baseChange_target_limit_geometry {X S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] (p : X ⟶ S) (g : T ⟶ S) {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Over T) [∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f).left] [∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i).left] [∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i).left] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget T).mapCone c)) : let B := Over.pullback (pullback.fst g p) (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom ((D ⋙ B).map f).left) ∧ (∀ i, QuasiCompact (((D ⋙ B).obj i).hom ≫ pullback.snd g p)) ∧ (∀ i, QuasiSeparated (((D ⋙ B).obj i).hom ≫ pullback.snd g p)) ∧ QuasiCompact ((B.mapCone c).pt.hom ≫ pullback.snd g p) ∧ QuasiSeparated ((B.mapCone c).pt.hom ≫ pullback.snd g p) ∧ Nonempty (IsLimit ((Over.forget (pullback g p)).mapCone (B.mapCone c)))
